question: Why is the supreme Eye of the Śiva pair worthy of reverential bowing?
premises: The Eye is of the nature of illumination.
The Eye belongs to the Śiva pair and is supreme.
inference: Because of its illuminating, all-powerful, and supreme nature, that Eye is bowed to.
uncertainties: The dual śivayoḥ may refer to Śiva and Śakti or another paired form.
plain_english: We bow to that supreme Eye of the two Śivas, whose nature is illumination and which possesses all power.
